blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Streaming digital humans produce detailed video while continuing speech as new text arrives. High-resolution denoising is costly, and text updates can cause repeated or interrupted speech. We present TaoMate-HD, an autoregressive model for high-resolution audio-video streaming. For each short segment, or chunk, two denoising steps establish coarse video structure at low resolution. A final step refines the video to high resolution, with audio generated throughout the same trajectory. Each stage passes its audiovisual predictions to the same stage of the next chunk as history. Across text updates, the model retains this history to infer what has already been spoken. Continuation training utilizes asymmetric text conditioning, with separate text windows for generation and distillation. Experiments show a 1.6x speedup over direct high-resolution generation with the same model and hardware. Optimized stage-parallel deployment provides a further 1.9x overall speedup over serial progressive generation. Our continuation training reduces character error rate by 11.18 percentage points relative to the baseline. The model also supports hour-long audiovisual generation. Our project page is https://taoliveaigc.github.io/TaoMate-HD.
blocks.zh: 流出数码人类制作出详细的视频,同时随着新文本的到来继续演讲. 高分辨去诺是代价高昂的,文本更新可能导致重复或中断演讲. 我们介绍TaoMate-HD,一种高分辨率音频视频流的自旋模型. 对于每个短段,或分块,两个去声步骤在低分辨率下建立粗糙的视频结构. 最后一步将视频精炼为高分辨度,音频在同一个轨迹中产生. 每个阶段的视听预测都传到与历史相同的下一个阶段。 通过文本更新,模型保留了这一历史来推断已经说过的话。 继续培训采用不对称的文本调制,并设有单独的文本窗口用于生成和蒸馏. 实验显示比起直接高分辨生成,具有相同的模型和硬件的1.6x速度. 最佳的相平行部署比系列相继生成提供了1.9x的总速度. 我们的继续训练比基线降低了11.18个百分点。 该模型还支持长达一小时的视听生成. 我们的项目网页是https://taoliveaigc.github.io/TaoMate-HD。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Interactive digital humans need to sustain speech and visual motion as new dialogue arrives.
Joint audio-video models generate both modalities from text [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] .
Recent streaming systems extend this process over successive short segments, or chunks [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] .
These streams must preserve fine details in faces, hands, and foreground objects while keeping speech continuous.
Meeting both requirements is difficult: high-resolution synthesis is expensive, and text updates can disrupt ongoing speech.
blocks.zh:
互动数码人类需要随着新对话的到来而维持言论和视觉运动.
联合音频视频模型从文本中生成两种模式[1,2,3,4].
最近的流线系统将这一过程延伸至连续的短段或块[5、6、7]。
这些溪流必须保留面部,手部和前方物体的精细细节,同时保持语音连续.
满足这两种要求都十分困难:高分辨率合成成本高昂,文本更新会干扰正在进行的演讲.

blocks.en:
Direct high-resolution generation processes a dense video-token grid at every denoising step.
Even early steps use this grid when they mainly establish scene layout and motion.
Few-step distillation reduces the number of steps [ 8 , 9 ] .
Progressive-resolution methods further reduce spatial computation by using coarser grids early in denoising [ 10 , 11 ] .
However, faster processing of one chunk does not remove the wait between chunks.
If a chunk needs the previous chunk’s final output as history, it must wait for all refinement to finish.
Stage-parallel inference overlaps denoising across chunks [ 12 ] , but requires usable audiovisual context before that final output.
blocks.zh:
直接的高分辨率生成在每一个解密步骤上都会处理一个密集的视频键网格.
甚至早期步骤在主要建立场景布局和运动时也会使用这个网格.
少步蒸馏可以减少步数[8,9].
渐进式分辨率方法通过早期去诺化时使用焦耳网格进一步减少空间计算 [10, 11].
然而,更快地处理一个块并不能消除块之间的等待。
如果一个块需要上一块作为历史的最后产出,它必须等待所有改进完成。
阶段平行推论在断块之间相互重叠[12],但在最后产出之前需要可用的视听环境。

blocks.en:
Speech continuity poses a related challenge when text changes during generation.
Streaming models retain audiovisual context across chunks [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] .
To continue speech, they must relate incoming text to the words already spoken.
Text-window boundaries need not coincide with sentence endings, so an update may arrive mid-sentence and include words already spoken.
Restarting from the first word repeats content, while stopping at the window boundary interrupts speech.
The model therefore needs recent audio to distinguish spoken context from upcoming dialogue.
blocks.zh:
当文本在生成过程中发生变化时,语音连续性构成一个相关的挑战。
流体模型保留了跨块的视听环境[5、6、7]。
为了继续发言,它们必须将即将提出的案文与已经讲过的文字联系起来。
文本窗口边界不需要与句尾重合,所以更新可能到达中刑,并包含已经讲过的词.
从第一个单词重新开始重复内容,同时停止窗口边界会打断语音.
因此,该模式需要最近的音频来区分口语背景和即将进行的对话。

blocks.en:
We present TaoMate-HD , an autoregressive model for high-resolution audio-video streaming (Figure 1 ).
Its central idea is to reuse audiovisual predictions before final spatial refinement is complete.
Each chunk first undergoes two denoising steps at low resolution to establish coarse video structure.
One final step refines the video to high resolution, while audio is generated throughout the joint trajectory.
Each stage estimates clean audio and video without waiting for the remaining denoising steps.
These estimates provide history for the same stage of the next chunk.
The next chunk can thus begin coarse generation before the previous chunk finishes high-resolution refinement.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍TaoMate-HD(图1),这是高分辨率音频视频流的自动递归模型。
其中心思想是在完成最终空间改进之前重新利用视听预测.
每个块首先经过两个低分辨率的调试步骤来建立粗细的视频结构.
最后一步将视频精炼到高分辨率,而音频则在整个联合轨迹中生成.
每一阶段都估算干净的音频和视频,而不等待其余的去名步骤.
这些估计数为下一块的同一阶段提供了历史。
因此,下一个块可以在前一个块完成高分辨率改进之前开始粗糙的生成。

blocks.en:
When the text window changes, we retain the audiovisual history and use overlapping text to provide continuation context.
The model infers speech progress from the retained audio, without an explicit text pointer or online speech recognizer.
We train this behavior on the model’s own generated sequences, including text-window changes and speech completion.
Training uses asymmetric text conditioning to separate generation from sequence-level supervision.
The generator receives upcoming dialogue, while distillation uses the opening text context to evaluate the full audiovisual sequence.
blocks.zh:
当文本窗口发生变化时,我们保留了视听历史,并使用重叠文本提供续写上下文.
该模型从保留音频推断语音进展,没有明确的文本指针或在线语音识别器.
我们用模型自己生成的序列来训练这种行为,包括文本窗口的修改和语音的完成.
训练使用不对称的文本调制来区分生成和序列级监督.
生成器接收即将到来的对话框,而蒸馏则使用打开的文本上下文来评价完整的视听序列.

blocks.en:
Experiments show that progressive generation is 1.60 × 1.60\times faster than direct high-resolution generation with the same model and hardware.
Compared with the baseline, our continuation training reduces character error rate from 30.75% to 19.57%.
We also demonstrate hour-long audiovisual generation.
blocks.zh:
实验显示,进步生成速度为1.60×1.60\时速比具有相同模型和硬件的直流高分辨率生成速度快.
与基线相比,我们的继续训练将角色错误率从30.75%降至19.57%.
我们还展示了长达一小时的视听制作。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: ∙ \bullet A progressive audio-video generator that concentrates denoising on a coarse grid. Stage-local audiovisual history enables overlapping generation across chunks. ∙ \bullet Continuation training with asymmetric text conditioning and student-generated history to support speech across overlapping text windows. ∙ \bullet Hour-long high-resolution audiovisual demonstrations and quantitative comparisons of spatial efficiency, deployment throughput, and transcript accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三:一个先进的音频视频生成器,它集中对粗网进行调试。 各个阶段的当地视听历史使得不同部分的生成相互重叠。 \bullet 继续使用不对称的文本调制和学生创造的历史来支持跨重叠文本窗口的语音。 屏蔽小时高分辨率视听演示和空间效率、部署吞吐量和记录准确性的数量比较。

blocks.en: A progressive audio-video generator that concentrates denoising on a coarse grid. Stage-local audiovisual history enables overlapping generation across chunks.
blocks.zh: 一个进步的音频视频生成器 集中调试粗网格 各个阶段的当地视听历史使得不同部分的生成相互重叠。

blocks.en: Continuation training with asymmetric text conditioning and student-generated history to support speech across overlapping text windows.
blocks.zh: 继续使用不对称文本调制和学生创造的历史来支持跨重叠文本窗口的语音.

blocks.en: Hour-long high-resolution audiovisual demonstrations and quantitative comparisons of spatial efficiency, deployment throughput, and transcript accuracy.
blocks.zh: 小时高分辨率视听演示和空间效率、部署吞吐量和记录准确性定量比较。

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Joint diffusion and flow models couple visual motion with speech and other acoustic content [ 1 , 3 , 2 , 4 ] .
Progressive distillation, consistency training, and distribution matching reduce sampling to a small number of evaluations [ 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] .
For streaming generation, these few-step trajectories must also learn to condition on previously generated content.
CausVid uses distribution matching to distill a bidirectional teacher into a causal generator, with teacher ODE trajectories for initialization [ 8 ] .
Self Forcing trains on student-generated histories and samples denoising exits for gradient computation [ 9 ] .
Recent AV systems combine such rollouts with multimodal objectives and streaming inference [ 5 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 ] .
LynnReal-Omni provides Standard and Flash joint-AV generators and extends generation through bounded latent history and boundary overlap [ 7 ] .
We likewise train on student-generated histories, but allow the generator’s text window to advance while the distillation scores evaluate the sequence from its opening context.
blocks.zh:
联合传播和流体模型将视觉运动与语音和其他声学内容结合[1,3,2,4].
逐步蒸馏、一致性培训和分布匹配将取样减少为少数评价[13、14、15、16]。
对于流体生成,这些几步轨迹还必须学会以以前生成的内容为条件.
CausVid使用分布匹配法将双向教师蒸馏成因果生成器,并配有教师ODE轨迹进行初始化[8].
自行强制列车在学生创造的历史和样本上卸下出口,进行梯度计算[9].
最近的AV系统将这种推出与多式联运目标和流推[5、17、18、19、20]结合起来。
LynnReal-Omni提供标准式和闪电式联合AV发电机,并通过有界限的潜在历史和边界重叠来扩展生成[7].
我们同样训练学生创造的历史, 但让生成者的文字窗口前进,

blocks.en:
Few-step sampling still pays for a dense grid at each evaluation.
Progressive spatial methods reduce this cost by varying resolution along the trajectory.
Matryoshka diffusion and pyramidal flow use multiple spatial scales within generation [ 21 , 10 ] .
PyramidalWan first adapts the original-architecture teacher to multiple resolutions through flow matching, then studies distribution matching with this teacher and a refitted pyramidal teacher [ 11 ] .
Its few-step schedule concentrates target-resolution computation in a single evaluation.
Spectral schedules and adaptive patch granularity likewise vary spatial computation with noise level [ 22 , 23 ] .
Video DeltaNet instead changes video-to-video attention through local Softmax, boundary anchors, and bidirectional linear memory, retaining Softmax interactions with text and audio [ 24 ] .
Causal super-resolution methods such as Ultra Flash take another approach, refining the output of a separate generator [ 25 ] .
We change resolution within the joint audiovisual trajectory rather than after generation, and make the intermediate audiovisual predictions available as history for subsequent chunks.
blocks.zh:
在每次评价中,很少步骤的取样仍然支付密集网格的费用。
渐进的空间方法通过沿轨迹的不同分辨率来降低这一成本。
Matryoshka扩散和金字塔流在生成内部使用多个空间尺度[21,10].
金字塔 Wan首先通过流量比对使原始-建筑学老师适应多个解析度,然后与这位老师和重排的金字塔老师学习分布比对[11].
它的几步时间表将目标分辨率计算集中在一个评价中.
光谱表和适应性补丁颗粒性也随着噪音水平而变化空间计算[22,23].
视频三角洲 Net转而通过本地Softmax,边界锚和双向线性内存来改变视频对视频的注意,保留Softmax与文本和音频的相互作用[24].
Ultra Flash等因果超解的方法采取了另一种方法,精炼了单独生成器的输出[25].
我们改变联合视听轨迹中的分辨率,而不是世代相传的分辨率,并将中间视听预测作为随后各部分的历史。

blocks.en:
Across chunks, efficiency also depends on when history becomes available.
Long-video generators retain context through windows of cached features, recurrent state, selected history, or persistent anchors [ 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 , 31 ] .
TaoMate separates an immutable visual anchor and adaptive audiovisual memory from the active KV cache, using memory attention and reference-aware modulation for long-form consistency [ 6 ] .
Its stage-parallel inference operates at a fixed spatial resolution.
Ripple also extends recurrent temporal state to joint audio-video generation [ 32 ] .
Stage-parallel inference organizes chunks and denoising stages into an anti-diagonal pipeline and fuses context writing with the next chunk’s denoising [ 12 ] .
The stage-specific history in that formulation is represented at the stage’s output noise level.
We use this execution organization with paired clean audiovisual predictions on each stage’s native grid.
The clean prediction provides a common history representation even though the query noise level and spatial grid differ between stages.
blocks.zh:
从各个部分来看,效率还取决于历史何时出现。
长视频生成器通过缓存特性窗口保留上下文,经常状态,选定历史,或持续锚 [26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31].
TaoMate将一个不可变的视觉主锚和适应性的视听内存与活跃的KV缓存分离,使用内存的注意和参考-意识的调制来进行长形式的一致性[6].
它的阶段平行推论以固定空间分辨率运行.
Ripple还将经常性时间状态延伸至联合音频-视频生成[32].
阶段平行推论将块和去诺级组织成反对角管道和引信上下文书写,下一个块去诺级 [12]。
该配方的阶段性历史表现在该阶段的产出噪音水平上。
我们使用这个处决组织,
干净的预测提供了共同的历史表现,尽管各个阶段的查询噪音水平和空间网格不同.

blocks.en: 3  Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
TaoMate-HD is an autoregressive audio-video model that uses coarse-to-fine denoising and stage-local KV history to generate a continuous stream (Figure 2 ).
Each chunk develops on a coarse video grid before high-resolution refinement, while intermediate audiovisual predictions provide context for subsequent chunks.
Training on the model’s own rollouts with asymmetric text conditioning supports speech continuation as the dialogue advances.
blocks.zh:
TaoMate-HD是一种自动递归的音频视频模型,它使用粗对细的解码和舞台局部的KV历史生成连续流(图2 ).
每个块在高分辨率改进之前在粗糙的视频网格上发展,中间视听预测则为随后的块提供了上下文.
关于该模型本身推出的培训采用不对称的文本条件,支持随着对话的推进而继续发言。

blocks.en:
Figure 2: A chunk’s refinement becomes the next chunk’s history. The N = 3 N=3 configuration shown here uses two coarse-grid evaluations followed by high-resolution refinement.
Each stage estimates a clean AV endpoint and encodes it on its native grid for the same stage of the next chunk, enabling the parallel execution shown at lower right.
Audio keeps its latent geometry throughout.
The lower-left panel shows training: selected-stage predictions form a high-resolution sequence for the two distillation scores.
The generator and scores share scene and speaker conditions, with role-specific dialogue windows.
blocks.zh:
图2:一个小块的改进成为下一个小块的历史。 这里显示的 N = 3 N = 3 配置使用两个粗网评价,然后进行高分辨率的改进.
每个阶段都估计一个干净的AV端点,并将它编码在其本土的网格上,用于下一个块的同一阶段,从而可以在右下方显示平行执行.
音频一直保持其潜在的几何特征.
左下角面板显示训练:选定阶段预测为两个蒸馏分数形成高分辨率序列.
生成器和分数共享场景和扬声器条件,并设有特定角色的对话窗口.

blocks.en: 3.1 Progressive generation
blocks.zh: 3.1 进步一代

blocks.en:
Direct high-resolution generation repeats full-grid attention at every denoising step, including early steps that establish scene layout and large-scale motion.
Progressive generation assigns this structural synthesis to a coarse grid and defers fine spatial refinement to the output grid.
For an N N -step trajectory, we perform the first N − 1 N-1 evaluations on a low-resolution video grid L L and the final evaluation on a high-resolution grid H H .
Audio retains the same latent geometry throughout, so video refinement and audio generation remain part of one joint trajectory.
blocks.zh:
直接高分辨率生成在每一个调试步骤上重复全网关注,包括建立场景布局和大规模运动的早期步骤.
渐进生成将这种结构合成分配到粗细的网格上,并将细细的空间完善推迟到输出网格上.
关于N-Step轨迹,我们对低分辨率视频网格LL进行第一次N-1评价,并对高分辨率网格H进行最后评价。
音频在整个过程中保留了相同的潜伏几何,因此视频的完善和音频生成仍然是一个联动轨迹的一部分.

blocks.en: 3.2 Stage-local KV history
blocks.zh: 3.2 阶段-当地KV历史

blocks.en:
Progressive generation reduces computation within a chunk, but overlapping chunks also requires history before final refinement finishes.
We therefore give each stage its own key/value (KV) history bank, built from the preceding chunk’s same-stage video and audio predictions.
The clean estimates in Equation 1 are encoded at zero noise ( σ = 0 \sigma=0 ) on that stage’s native spatial grid.
This encoding turns an intermediate endpoint estimate into reusable context without waiting for later denoising stages.
The coarse-stage banks remain separate because they contain predictions at different refinement levels, while the final-stage bank stores the high-resolution endpoint.
blocks.zh:
渐进生成减少块内的计算,但重叠块还需要历史才能完成最后的完善。
因此,我们给每个阶段自己的钥匙/价值(KV)历史库,这是从前一个阶段的视频和音频预测中建造的。
方程式1的清洁估计值被编码为该级本土空间网格上的零噪声(σ=0\sigma=0).
这种编码将中间端点估计转换为可重复使用的上下文,而不等待以后的去诺化阶段.
粗细阶段的银行仍然单独存在,因为它们包含不同精度的预测,而末期的银行则存储高分辨率的端点.

blocks.en:
Let 𝒯 b , ℓ \mathcal{T}_{b,\ell} denote stage ℓ ∈ { 1 , … , N } \ell\in\{1,\ldots,N\} of chunk b b .
It requires the preceding stage of its own chunk and the same stage of the preceding chunk: 𝒯 b , ℓ ← { 𝒯 b , ℓ − 1 , 𝒯 b − 1 , ℓ } . \mathcal{T}_{b,\ell}\ \leftarrow\ \{\mathcal{T}_{b,\ell-1},\mathcal{T}_{b-1,\ell}\}. (3) These dependencies permit stage-parallel inference [ 12 ] : later chunks can occupy coarse stages while an earlier chunk undergoes final refinement.
Each stage keeps its KV history local and passes current-chunk audiovisual latents downstream.
Within a text window, coarse stages fuse encoding of the preceding chunk’s clean estimate with denoising of the current noisy chunk [ 12 ] .
A causal mask lets the noisy chunk read that estimate and earlier history, while the context chunk reads prior history and itself.
blocks.zh:
让 Tb, l\ mathcal{T}_{b,\ell} 表示阶段 l {{1,..., N}\ell\in\1,\ldots, N} 块 b b 。
它需要自己块的上一个阶段和前一个块的上一个阶段: Tb, l {Tb, l ─ 1 , T b ─ 1 , l } 。\ mathcal{T}_{b,\ ell }\ leftarrow\ {Mathcal{T}_{b,\ ell-1},\ mathcal{T}_{b-1,\ ell}。 (3) 这些依赖性允许进行阶段平行推论[12]:以后的块可占据粗糙的阶段,而较早的块则经过最后的改进。
每一阶段都保持其KV历史本地化,并在下游传递流体视听潜质.
在文本窗口内,粗细的相位引信对上块的清洁估计值进行编码,对当前吵闹的块进行去诺[12]。
一个因果面罩让吵闹的块读出这个估计和较早的历史,而上下文块读出以前的历史和本身.

blocks.en:
For long-stream inference, each bank retains the initial chunk’s video as a visual anchor and the two most recent chunks’ paired video and audio.
Initial audio remains available while it lies in this recent window.
The fixed-capacity banks preserve appearance and recent speech context without growing with stream duration.
KV and cached text projections are stored separately.
A text-window change refreshes the latter, leaving retained KV encoded under their original conditions.
Before the switch, any pending clean prediction is committed at noise using the old window that generated it.
Algorithm 1 summarizes this update for each stage.
blocks.zh:
在长流推论中,每个银行保留最初的块视频作为视觉主播,以及最近两块的对视频和音频。
初始音频仍然可用,而它位于最近的窗口中。
固定容量库保存外观和近期的语音环境,不会随着流长而增加。
KV和缓存的文本预测单独存储.
一个文本窗口的更改刷新了后者,留下了保留在原始条件下编码的KV.
在开关前,任何待决的清洁预测都是在使用生成它的旧窗口的噪音下做出的.
算法1总结了每个阶段的这一更新.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 KV update at a text-window boundary
blocks.zh: 在文本窗口边界上更新算法 1 KV

blocks.en:
Thus new text controls future synthesis without re-encoding the generated past.
Spatial coordinates remain native to each grid, and temporal positions continue across windows.
Training uses the same update order but retains the full causal prefix of its short rollouts.
blocks.zh:
因此,新文本控制未来的合成,而不重新编码生成的过去。
空间坐标仍然是每个网格的原生坐标,时间位置继续跨越窗口。
训练使用相同的更新顺序,但保留了短期推出的全部因果前缀.

blocks.en: 3.3 Asymmetric distillation for continuation
blocks.zh: 3.3 供继续使用的不对称蒸馏

blocks.en:
Speech continuation requires relating new dialogue to the retained audio history.
We use overlapping text windows because updates can arrive mid-sentence.
Let A A be earlier text, B B the shared span, and C C new dialogue.
The generator moves from the initial window W 1 = A + B W_{1}=A+B to W 2 = B + C W_{2}=B+C while retaining history, using B B as context rather than restarting it.
At inference, audio history and text indicate speech progress without ASR, text pointers, or alignment modules.
blocks.zh:
发言的继续需要将新的对话与保留的音频历史联系起来。
我们使用重叠的文本窗口,因为更新可以到达中期。
让A成为更早的案文,让B成为共同的跨度,让C成为新的对话。
生成器从初始窗口W 1 = A + B W_{1}=A+B → W 2 = B + C W_{2}=B+ C同时保留历史,使用B B作为上下文,而不是重启.
推论中,音频历史和文本表示没有ASR,文本指针,或对齐模块的语音进度.

blocks.en:
We train this behavior on student-generated rollouts [ 9 ] .
The student executes all N N stages, updates its own history banks, and switches text at a sampled chunk boundary.
To construct the windows, we extend source transcripts with same-topic speech while preserving the original wording, language, and speaker assignments.
Source speaking rate maps nominal time intervals to character or word spans.
The initial window A + B A+B covers the entire nominal rollout horizon even when the switch occurs earlier.
blocks.zh:
我们通过学生创造的推广来训练这种行为 [9].
学生执行所有 N N 阶段, 更新自己的历史库, 并在一个样本块边界上切换文本 。
为了构筑这些窗口,我们在保留原始措辞、语言和演讲者任务的同时,还扩展了同专题发言的源记录。
源语速率将标定的时间间隔映射到字符或字段.
初始窗口A+B A+B覆盖了整个名义的推出视野,即使开关发生时间更早.

blocks.en:
Distribution-matching distillation (DMD) supervises these rollouts by comparing a frozen teacher score with a learned score of the student’s distribution [ 15 , 16 ] .
The generator needs W 2 W_{2} to continue the next chunk, whereas both scores evaluate the concatenated sequence from its beginning.
The learned fake score therefore retains W 1 W_{1} : it includes the opening words absent from W 2 W_{2} and the extended dialogue conditioning the student’s rollout.
The frozen real score instead uses the original source transcript prefix through the rollout duration.
This ties the teacher reference to the source segment, while the appended dialogue serves as generation lookahead.
Scene descriptions, speaker attributes, and audiovisual alignment instructions are shared across all three roles during training.
blocks.zh:
发行匹配蒸馏(DMD)监督这些推出,将冻结的教师分数与学生分配的学习分数进行比较[15,16].
生成器需要W 2 W% 2} 来继续下一块, 而两个分数都从开始就评价了整齐序列 。
因此,所学的假分数保留了W 1 W_{1}: 包括W2 W_{2}的开场白,
冷冻真实分数转而通过推出时间段使用原始的源语录前缀.
这把老师的参考内容与源部分联系起来,而所附的对话则充当一代前卫。
在培训期间,所有三个角色都分享场景描述、演讲者属性和视听协调指示。

blocks.en: The generator uses W 1 W_{1} before the switch and W 2 W_{2} afterward, with ellipses marking omitted words:
blocks.zh: 生成器在开关前使用W 1 W_{1},之后使用W 2 W_{2},椭圆标记省略词:

blocks.en: Generator ( W 2 W_{2} ) a set of free templates you can download and use right away. These templates are designed to … Fake ( W 1 W_{1} ) this into my own post-processing workflow. … a set of free templates you can download and use right away. These templates are designed Real (source prefix) this into my own post-processing workflow. … I’ll even give you a set
blocks.zh: 生成器(W 2 W_{2}) 一组免费模板,您可以马上下载和使用. 这些模板旨在. 假的(W1 W_{1}1}),这个进入我自己的后处理工作流程. . . . .  .... 一组免费模板,可以立即下载和使用。 这些模板被设计为Real(源代码前缀),进入我自己的后处理工作流程. . 我甚至会给你一套

blocks.en:
Both scores receive the same audiovisual sequence, corruption noise, and noise levels, so their difference defines the DMD update at a common noisy state.
The fake score learns from detached student sequences by velocity regression with an independent noise draw.
blocks.zh:
两个分数都得到相同的视听序列,腐败噪音,和噪音水平,因此他们的区别定义了DMD在常见的吵吵状态下更新.
假分通过独立噪声图的速率回归来从分离的学生序列中学习.

blocks.en:
To supervise every refinement level, we sample one stage per rollout and concatenate its clean predictions across chunks.
The selected stage is shared across chunks so the sequence has a consistent refinement level.
For a coarse stage, bilinear interpolation enlarges the clean video latents to H H , leaving time, channels, and audio unchanged.
This gives both scores a common high-resolution supervision canvas .
The student continues to denoise on each stage’s native grid.
Resizing the predicted clean video for scoring lets the high-resolution teacher supervise coarse stages without changing their computational resolution.
All N N stages still execute for every chunk, irrespective of the stage selected for supervision.
blocks.zh:
为了监督每个完善水平, 我们每推出一个阶段 并将其清洁的预测 凝聚在块。
所选择的阶段在块之间共享,因此序列具有一致的精度.
对于粗糙的舞台,双线插值将干净的视频潜伏到HH,留下时间,频道,音频不变.
这给了两个分数 一个常见的高分辨率监督画布。
这名学生继续在舞台的原生网格上露面。
调整预言的清真视频以评分,让高清老师监督粗细的阶段而不改变其计算分辨率.
所有N级N级仍为每块执行,无论选择哪个阶段进行监督.

blocks.en:
We first construct the rollout without gradients, then replay the selected evaluation one chunk at a time.
Each replayed prediction replaces its region in the otherwise detached canvas, and a chunk mask restricts the update to that region.
The scores retain full-sequence context, while gradients flow through the active prediction and its spatial interpolation, excluding other chunks and cached history.
An auxiliary teacher target supports final-stage detail refinement.
For a sampled noninitial chunk, the frozen base model starts from the student’s lifted state, conditions on preceding final clean audiovisual chunks, and denoises to an endpoint.
We regress the student’s final video prediction toward this target, complementing the joint audiovisual DMD objective.
blocks.zh:
我们首先构建没有梯度的展开,然后一次重播选定的评价。
每一次重播的预测都会在原本分离的画布中取代其区域,一个块面罩会限制对该区域的更新.
分数保留了全序上下文,而梯度流经主动预测及其空间插值,不包括其他块和缓存历史.
一个辅助教师目标支持最后阶段细节的完善.
冰冻的基座模式从学生的解除状态、之前最后干净的视听块的条件以及凹陷到终点。
校对:Soup

blocks.en:
Training also includes speech-completion examples so the model learns when to stop speaking as well as how to continue.
We select source clips whose endpoint is confirmed offline by the transcript, timestamped ASR, and voice activity detection [ 34 ] , and extend the rollout beyond that endpoint.
Here A + B A+B is the full original transcript: the generator first receives A + B A+B , then its final span B B , with no added C C .
Both scores receive the full transcript and an instruction to finish the unspoken remainder and then produce natural nonspeech behavior.
Audio history indicates whether words remain to be spoken or the utterance has ended.
blocks.zh:
培训还包括讲完语法的例子,以便模型学会何时停止发言以及如何继续。
我们选择了源片段,其端点通过笔录被离线确认,时间戳ASR,以及语音活动检测[34],并将推出范围扩展到该端点之后.
这里A + B A + B 是完整的原始文本:生成者先收到A + B A + B ,然后是其最后的跨度 B ,没有增加 C .
两个分数都收到完整的笔录,并指示完成未讲完的剩余部分,然后产生自然的非言论行为.
音频历史表明话语是否仍待说,或者话语是否已经结束.

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价设置

blocks.en: We evaluate long-form quality, isolate spatial-schedule efficiency, and measure gains from deployment and continuation training.
blocks.zh: 我们评价长式质量,孤立空间时间表的效率,并衡量部署和继续培训的成果。

blocks.en:
We train rank-128 LoRA on 10,000 self-constructed distillation pairs, starting from MiniMax-H3 FL2VA model [ 35 ] .
We evaluate the methods on 100 self-constructed sequences lasting 1–10 minutes, each comprising successive five-second text requests.
Outputs are 768 × \times 1376 at 24 FPS with 32-kHz stereo audio.
We also generate hour-long audiovisual streams by continuing the autoregressive rollout across successive text windows.
Figure 1 shows samples at 1376 × 768 1376\times 768 , with frames sampled from the opening to 60 seconds to illustrate persistent character appearance and scene composition.
blocks.zh:
我们从MiniMax-H3 FL2VA型号[35]开始,在10,000对自建蒸馏对上进行军衔-128 LoRA的训练.
我们用100个自建的顺序来评价方法,每次持续1至10分钟,每个顺序包括连续5秒的文本请求。
产出为768 ×\times 1376 at 24 FPS,32 k Hz立体声.
我们还通过连续的文本窗口自动推出,产生长达一小时的视听流。
图1显示样本为1376×768 1376\time768,框架样本从开口到60秒,以说明持久性字符外观和场景组成.

blocks.en:
Table 1 uses VABench VisualRealism, AudioAes, LipSync, and Desync for visual quality, audio quality, and audiovisual synchronization [ 41 ] .
Temporal measures frame-difference stability, while Long-range measures color/brightness continuity across full sequences.

SyncNet LSE-C/D [ 43 , 44 ] average valid five-second windows over each full output.
Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCCs) summarize the short-time spectral envelope.
We compare their mean-and-standard-deviation vectors over the first and last five seconds by cosine similarity to measure endpoint acoustic consistency.
For the spatial ablation, Video averages normalized sharpness, contrast, exposure, and saturation, while Audio averages loudness, clipping, silence prevalence, and audiovisual-duration agreement.
Efficiency is measured by GPUs per stream, generation FPS, and first ordered RGB latency.

我们用余弦的相似性来比较它们的第一个和最后五个秒的中标准偏移矢量,以测量端点的声学一致性.
在空间衰减方面,视频平均的锐度、对比度、曝光度和饱和度都趋于正常,而音频平均的响度、剪辑率、沉默率和视听时间协议。

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with audio-video generators
blocks.zh: 4.2 与音频视频发电机的比较

blocks.en:
Table 1 organizes the comparison into audio-video foundation and accelerated clip models, speech-to-video (S2V) systems, and streaming audio-video generators.
The first group comprises MiniMax-H3 [ 35 ] , VDN [ 24 ] , LTX-2.3 [ 1 ] , JavisDiT++ [ 2 ] , MOVA [ 4 ] , and OVI [ 3 ] .
The S2V group comprises OmniAvatar [ 36 ] , StableAvatar [ 37 ] , Wan2.2-S2V [ 38 ] , LiveAvatar [ 39 ] , and Hallo3 [ 40 ] , which animate video from supplied speech.
The streaming group comprises OmniForcing [ 5 ] , Lynn Standard/Flash [ 7 ] , and TaoMate [ 6 ] , which jointly generate speech and video across successive temporal blocks.
blocks.zh:
表1对音频视频基础和加速剪辑模型、语音对视频(S2V)系统和流传音频视频生成器进行了比较。
第一组包括MiniMax-H3 [35],VDN [24],LTX-2.3 [1],JavisDIT++ [2],MOVA [4]和OVI [3].
S2V组包括OmniAvatar[36],StableAvatar[37],Wan2.2-S2V[38],LiveAvatar[39],和Hallo3[40],这些视频是从提供的演讲中提供动画视频.
溪流组包括OmniForcing [5],Lynn Standard/Flash [7],和TaoMate [6],它们共同生成跨越连续时间块的语音和视频.

blocks.en:
The models extend generation through different forms of context.
MiniMax-H3 and VDN extend an opening T2AV clip with successive I2AV clips.
Lynn retains persistent media KV, while ours combines retained audiovisual history with overlapping dialogue and evolving scenes.
MiniMax-H3 uses 49 denoising evaluations per five-second request, VDN uses eight, and the Lynn variants use four or three per autoregressive window.
Our model uses three denoising evaluations and three clean-history encodings per chunk.
blocks.zh:
模型通过不同形式的上下文扩展生成.
MiniMax-H3和VDN扩展了一个开口的T2AV剪辑,并附有连续的I2AV剪辑.
林恩保留了持久的媒体KV,而我们的媒体将保留下来的视听历史与重叠的对话和不断变化的场景结合起来。
MiniMax-H3每5秒请求使用49个解密评价,VDN使用8个,Lynn变体使用4个或3个每自动递归窗口.
我们的模型每块使用三个去名评价 和三个干净的历史编码。

blocks.en:
Table 1 reports quality for both serial and parallel configurations.
Our interval spans prepared input to decoded AV, while the MiniMax-H3, VDN, and Lynn intervals include online conditioning and encoding/mux.

串行道Mate-HD在表1中得分最高的Temperal和AudioAes:0.913和4.407,相比之下,OmniForcing的得分是0.786和3.571,而TaoMate的得分是0.843和3.889.
它在这一组中实现了报告的最低核证的排减量,为19.57%。
它还与Lynn-Flash分享最佳视觉现实主义和Desync价值观.

Table 2 compares resolution and execution settings, with direct 480p generation as the low-resolution reference.
The middle FPS entries compare spatial schedules, while the final row reports deployment throughput.
For the spatial timing comparison, Direct (768p) and serial Progressive share the generator, inputs, request seeds, stage-local AV history, and BF16/SDPA execution, changing the resolution schedule while retaining the temporal schedule and decoding policy.

blocks.en:
Averaging wall time equally over inputs and repeated executions, Progressive reduces generation time from 491 to 307 seconds.
The ratio of these mean times gives a 1.60 × 1.60\times spatial speedup (Table 2 ).
The analytic video-linear work ratio is 0.595, whereas measured wall time additionally includes context encoding, audio computation, communication, and decoding.
Figure 4 shows the detail retained under this reduced spatial workload: enlarged views expose hand contours and product surfaces after progressive refinement to 768p.
blocks.zh:
" 进步 " 将生产时间从491秒减少到307秒。
这些平均时间的比例给出了1.60×1.60\时间的空间速度(表2).
分析视频线的工作比率为0.595,而测量的墙壁时间额外包括上下文编码、音频计算、通信和解码。

blocks.en:
We next combine the progressive trajectory with the optimized stage-parallel deployment.
Mean generation time decreases from 307 seconds for serial progressive to 160 seconds, a 1.92 × 1.92\times overall acceleration (Table 2 ).
This is a deployment-level comparison: it combines overlapping stages, low-stage fusion, KV reuse, selective W8A8 projections, a different attention implementation, and codec scheduling.
The resulting configuration reaches 8.99 FPS, with its quality measurements listed in the final row.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来将逐步轨迹与最佳阶段平行部署结合起来。
平均生成时间从序列递进的307秒减少到160秒,一个1.92×1.92\时间整体加速(表2).
这是一个部署层面的比较:它结合了重叠阶段,低级聚变,KV再利用,选择性的W8A8预测,不同的关注执行,以及编码调度.
由此产生的配置达到8.99 FPS,其质量测量在最后一行列出.

The proposed asymmetric distillation reduces CER from 30.8% to 19.6%, an 11.2-point improvement (Table 3 ).

The configuration labeled w/o asymmetric distillation shares text between the generator and both scores.

标记为w/o的不对称衍射的配置在生成器和两个分数之间共享文本.
端点MFCC的余弦从0.971增加到0.979,表明开口语和闭口语之间的声学特征更加一致.

blocks.en: 5  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented TaoMate-HD to reduce the computational cost of high-resolution audiovisual streaming while maintaining speech continuity.
Progressive denoising establishes coarse video structure before final high-resolution refinement, while stage-local KV history enables overlapping generation across chunks.
Distillation with asymmetric text conditioning teaches the model to use retained audiovisual history as dialogue windows advance.
Experiments show that progressive generation achieves a 1.60 × 1.60\times speedup over direct generation while retaining fine visual detail.
The optimized stage-parallel deployment provides a further 1.92 × 1.92\times speedup. Asymmetric distillation reduces CER from 30.8% to 19.6%.
Together, these advances support high-resolution audiovisual generation extending to an hour.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了TaoMate-HD,以减少高分辨率视听流的计算成本,同时保持语音连续性。
逐渐解密在最后的高分辨率改进之前建立粗糙的视频结构,而舞台局部的KV历史则使各个块的生成相互重叠。
使用不对称文本调制的稀释法教导模型在对话窗口前进时使用保留下来的视听历史。
实验表明,渐进生成在保持精细视觉细节的同时,可以实现1.60×1.60\时的速度超过直接生成.
优化的阶段平行部署提供了1.92×1.92\时速的进一步加速. 不对称蒸馏使CER从30.8%降至19.6%.
这些进步共同支持高分辨率的视听生成,持续到一小时。
